answer: Each identity must lock a bond of 500 units plus a unique hardware credential, so no agent holds two identities without a second bond and device. An attacker registering k fakes locks 500k units, waits three epochs per registration, and loses 100% of every bond on detection. Splitting identities gains nothing because marginal cost per fake stays 500 units, any single caught fake slashes its shared bond pool, and a wander plume relic detector flags duplicate credentials.
